notes.title: 10 Second Ninja X - April Update!
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

We've released the latest update for 10 Second Ninja X today - which adds some new levels and a few general fixes.

The new bonus room adds 5 levels which we developed especially for the GameMaker edition demo last year - and also introduces a new marathon mode for these levels; with full leaderboard support. The bonus room becomes accessible once you've beaten the main game and can be found next to George's marathon mode door in the hub.

This update also fixes a few bugs that a small number of you have been experiencing. We'll be keeping an eye on these issues and will be updating accordingly.

Thanks for supporting us, and we hope you enjoy the latest additions & changes!

FCI & Curve Digital

notes.title: 10 Second Ninja X - September Update
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

We've released the latest update for 10 Second Ninja X today, which features a bunch of fixes and a few tweaks to improve the overall experience.

A few of you were having difficulty getting through the first world, so we've lowered the barrier to entry here - you only need 16 stars to get to the 2nd set of levels. Once you're through to the 2nd world, you'll have access to Greatbeard's Arcade where you can play Kat's Crate Smash to unlock hint tokens to help you through some of the trickier levels.

Recently we've also added settings which allow you to modify the intensity of the flashes throughout the game, along with a number of optimisation options that you can find in the settings menu. 

Finally, we've also switched up the vsync method we were using, which should address a frame rate issue that a small number of players have been reporting. 

Thanks for supporting us, and we hope you enjoy the latest changes!

FCI & Curve Digital
